meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从你的代码库里识别业务领域、业务流程和步骤,生成一张可交互的横向流程图并显示在仪表板上。如果项目里已有知识图谱,它会直接从中提取,不再重新扫描文件。
howto.when: 当你说“/understand-domain”(可加参数 --full)时触发。若项目已有知识图谱则直接从中派生,否则做一次轻量代码扫描。

say.note: 强制重新扫描代码,忽略已有知识图谱。

say.text: 项目里有 /understand 图谱,帮我派生领域图
say.note: 直接复用现有图谱,不重新扫描文件。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts business domains, flows, and steps from your codebase and shows an interactive horizontal flowchart in the dashboard. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it instead of rescanning files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /understand-domain. If a knowledge graph already exists, it derives from it; otherwise it does a lightweight scan. The --full flag forces a fresh scan.

say_en.note: Generates an interactive domain flow diagram.
Forces a fresh scan, ignoring any existing knowledge graph.

say_en.text: I have an /understand graph; derive the domain view
say_en.note: Reuses the existing graph without scanning files.
